readings.title: Proclaiming the Name
readings.subtitle: The Rock and His Perfect Work
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 31:30] Then Mosheh spoke in the hearing of all the assembly of Yisra’el <dn>את</dn> the words of this song until they were ended: [Deuteronomy 32:1] “Give ear, O heavens, and let me speak; And hear, O earth, the words of my mouth. [2] “Let my instruction fall as rain, My speech drop down as dew, As fine rain on the tender plants, And as showers on the grass. [3] “For I proclaim the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Ascribe greatness to our <dn>Elohim</dn>. [4] “The Rock! <dn>His</dn> work is perfect, For all <dn>His</dn> ways are right-ruling, An <dn>Ěl</dn> of truth and without unrighteousness, Righteous and straight is <dn>He</dn>.

readings.title: The Corruption of the People
readings.subtitle: Forgetting the Father Who Bought Them
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 32:5] “A twisted and crooked generation has corrupted itself, Their blemish, they are not <dn>His</dn> children. [6] “Do you do this to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O foolish and unwise people? Is <dn>He</dn> not your Father, who bought you, Who created you and established you? [7] “Remember the days of old, Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father and let him show you, Your elders, and let them say to you: [8] “When the <dn>Most High</dn> gave the nations their inheritance, When <dn>He</dn> separated the sons of Aḏam, <dn>He</dn> set the boundaries of the peoples According to the number of the children of Yisra’el. [9] “For the portion of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is <dn>His</dn> people, Yaʽaqoḇ <dn>His</dn> allotted inheritance. [10] “<dn>He</dn> found him in a wilderness land, And in the waste, a howling desert. <dn>He</dn> encompassed him, <dn>He</dn> looked after him, <dn>He</dn> guarded him as the apple of <dn>His</dn> eye. [11] “As an eagle stirs up its nest, Flutters over its young, Spreading out its wings, taking them up, Carrying them on its wings. [12] “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> alone led him, And there was no strange mighty one with him. [13] “<dn>He</dn> made him ride in the heights of the earth, And he ate the fruit of the fields, And <dn>He</dn> made him to draw honey from the rock, And oil from the flinty rock, [14] “Curds from the cattle, and milk of the flock, With fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, With the choicest wheat; And you drank wine, the blood of the grapes.

readings.title: Jeshurun Grew Fat and Kicked
readings.subtitle: Provoking YeHoVaH to Jealousy
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 32:15] “But Yeshurun grew fat and kicked; You grew fat, you grew thick, you are covered with fat; So he forsook <dn>Eloah</dn> who made him, And scorned the Rock of his deliverance. [16] “They moved <dn>Him</dn> to jealousy with strange mighty ones, With abominations they provoked <dn>Him</dn>. [17] “They slaughtered to demons – not <dn>Eloah</dn> – Mighty ones they did not know, New ones who came lately, Which your fathers did not fear. [18] “You neglected the Rock who brought you forth, And forgot the <dn>Ěl</dn> who fathered you. [19] “And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> saw, and despised, Because of the provocation of <dn>His</dn> sons and <dn>His</dn> daughters. [20] “And <dn>He</dn> said, <dq>‘Let <dn>Me</dn> hide <dn>My</dn> face from them, Let <dn>Me</dn> see what their end is, For they are a perverse generation, Children in whom there is no trusting.</dq> [21] <dq>‘They made <dn>Me</dn> jealous by what is not <dn>Ěl</dn>, They provoked <dn>Me</dn> with their worthless matters. But <dn>I</dn> make them jealous by those who are no people, <dn>I</dn> provoke them with a foolish nation.</dq> [22] <dq>‘For a fire is kindled in <dn>My</dn> wrath, And burns to the bottom of She’ol, And consumes the earth and its increase, And sets on fire the foundations of mountains.</dq> [23] <dq>‘<dn>I</dn> gather evils upon them, <dn>I</dn> spend <dn>My</dn> arrows upon them –</dq> [24] <dq>‘Wasted by hunger, and devoured by pestilence And bitter destruction; And the teeth of beasts <dn>I</dn> send upon them, With the poison of serpents of the dust.</dq> [25] <dq>‘The sword bereaves from the outside, And fear from within, Both young man and exhausted virgin, The nursing child with the man of grey hairs.</dq>

readings.title: The Judgment of the Nations
readings.subtitle: Their Rock is Not Our Rock
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 32:26] <dq>‘<dn>I</dn> said, “<dn>I</dn> should blow them away, <dn>I</dn> should make the remembrance of them to cease from among men,”</dq> [27] <dq>‘If <dn>I</dn> did not fear the provocation of the enemy, Lest their adversaries should misunderstand, Lest they should say, “Our hand is high, And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has not done all this.” ’</dq> [28] “For they are a nation lost to counsel, And there is no understanding in them. [29] “If they were wise, they would understand this, They would consider their latter end! [30] “How would one chase a thousand, And two put ten thousand to flight, Unless their Rock had sold them, And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had surrendered them? [31] “For their rock is not like our <dn>Rock</dn>, Even our enemies are judges. [32] “For their vine is of the vine of Seḏom And of the fields of Amorah; Their grapes are grapes of gall, Their clusters are bitter. [33] “Their wine is the poison of serpents, And the fierce venom of cobras. [34] <dq>‘Is it not stored up with <dn>Me</dn>, Sealed up among <dn>My</dn> treasures?</dq> [35] <dq>‘Vengeance is <dn>Mine</dn>, and repayment, At the time their foot slips; For the day of their calamity is near, And the future things hasten upon them.’</dq> [36] “For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> rightly rules <dn>His</dn> people And has compassion on <dn>His</dn> servants, When <dn>He</dn> sees that their power is gone, And there is no one remaining, shut up or at large. [37] “And <dn>He</dn> shall say, <dq>‘Where are their mighty ones, The rock in which they sought refuge?</dq> [38] <dq>‘Who ate the fat of their slaughterings, And drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them arise and help you, Let it be a hiding-place for you!</dq>

readings.title: I Kill and I Make Alive
readings.subtitle: The Ultimate Authority of YeHoVaH
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 32:39] <dq>‘See now that <dn>I</dn>, <dn>I</dn> am <dn>He</dn>, And there is no <dn>Elohim</dn> besides <dn>Me</dn>. <dn>I</dn> put to death and <dn>I</dn> make alive. <dn>I</dn> have wounded, and <dn>I</dn> heal. And there is no one who delivers from <dn>My</dn> hand.</dq> [40] <dq>‘For <dn>I</dn> lift <dn>My</dn> hand to the heavens, And shall say: As <dn>I</dn> live forever,</dq> [41] <dq>‘If <dn>I</dn> sharpen <dn>My</dn> flashing sword, And <dn>My</dn> hand takes hold on judgment, <dn>I</dn> shall return vengeance to <dn>My</dn> enemies, And repay those who hate <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [42] <dq>‘<dn>I</dn> make <dn>My</dn> arrows drunk with blood, And <dn>My</dn> sword devours flesh, With the blood of the slain and the captives, From the long-haired heads of the enemy.’</dq> [43] “O nations, acclaim <dn>His</dn> people! For <dn>He</dn> avenges the blood of <dn>His</dn> servants, And returns vengeance to <dn>His</dn> adversaries, And shall pardon <dn>His</dn> land, <dn>His</dn> people.” [44] Then Mosheh came, with Hoshea son of Nun, and spoke <dn>את</dn> all the words of this song in the hearing of the people. [45] And when Mosheh ended speaking <dn>את</dn> all these words to all Yisra’el, [46] he said to them, “Set your hearts on all the words which I warn you today, so that you command <dn>את</dn> your children to guard to do <dn>את</dn> all the Words of this Torah. [47] “For it is not a worthless Word for you, because it is your life, and by this Word you prolong your days on the soil which you pass over the Yarden to possess.”

readings.title: Command to Ascend Mount Nebo
readings.subtitle: Mosheh to be Gathered to His People
readings.text: [Deuteronomy 32:48] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh that same day, saying, [49] <dq>“Go up this mountain of the Aḇarim, Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Mo’aḇ, which is opposite Yeriḥo, and look at <dn>את</dn> the land of Kenaʽan, which <dn>I</dn> give to the children of Yisra’el as a possession,</dq> [50] <dq>and die on the mountain which you ascend, and be gathered to your people, just as Aharon your brother died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,</dq> [51] <dq>because you trespassed against <dn>Me</dn> in the midst of the children of Yisra’el at the waters of Meriḇah Qaḏesh, in the Wilderness of Tsin, because you did not set <dn>Me</dn> apart in the midst of the children of Yisra’el.</dq> [52] <dq>“For you shall look at <dn>את</dn> the land before you, but you shall not enter there into the land which <dn>I</dn> am giving to the children of Yisra’el.”</dq>

readings.subsection: A Meditation on Eternity and Frailty
readings.title: From Everlasting to Everlasting
readings.subtitle: Numbering Our Days
readings.text: [Psalm 90:1] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> have been our refuge in all generations. [2] Before the mountains were born, Or <dn>You</dn> had formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, <dn>You</dn> are <dn>Ěl</dn>. [3] <dn>You</dn> turn man back to dust, And say, <dq>“Turn back, O children of men.”</dq> [4] For a thousand years in <dn>Your</dn> eyes Are like yesterday when it is past, And like a watch in the night. [5] <dn>You</dn> flood them away, they are asleep. In the morning they are like grass growing up. [6] In the morning it flourishes and grows up; In the evening it is cut down and withers. [7] For we are consumed by <dn>Your</dn> anger, And by <dn>Your</dn> wrath we are troubled. [8] <dn>You</dn> have set our crookednesses before <dn>You</dn>, Our secret sin in the light of <dn>Your</dn> face. [9] For all our days have passed away in <dn>Your</dn> wrath; We finish our years like a sigh. [10] The days of our lives are seventy years; And if by reason of strength they are eighty years, Yet their boast is only labour and sorrow; For it is soon cut off, and we fly away. [11] Who knows the power of <dn>Your</dn> anger? And <dn>Your</dn> wrath, according to the fear of <dn>You</dn>? [12] Teach us to number our days, That we may bring a heart of wisdom. [13] Return, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! How long? And have compassion on <dn>Your</dn> servants. [14] Satisfy us in the morning with <dn>Your</dn> kindness, And let us sing for joy and be glad all our days. [15] Make us glad according to the days <dn>You</dn> have afflicted us, And the years we have seen evil. [16] Let <dn>Your</dn> work appear to <dn>Your</dn> servants, And <dn>Your</dn> splendour to their children. [17] And let the pleasantness of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> be upon us, And establish the work of our hands for us; Yea, establish the work of our hands.
